items.name: 01-hero
items.prompt: Photorealistic interior photography, real estate photo, Scandinavian farmhouse style, realistic proportions, clean and calm, no people, no text, no labels, no logos, no brand names, plain unbranded jars and containers with no prints, high detail. Palette: white oak, cream, sage green, terracotta accents, natural daylight. A British kitchen with sage green Shaker base units and a white oak worktop. Above the worktop, two wall cupboards with their doors removed show neatly organised shelves: on the lower shelf everyday white plates stacked on the shelf and white bowls on a simple white wire shelf riser, on the upper shelf glass jars of pasta, rice and oats in matching plain clear jars, and a row of plain mugs. Everything is tidy, evenly spaced and clearly supported by the shelves. Straight-on view, soft daylight from a window on the left.

items.name: 02-sort
items.prompt: Photorealistic interior photography, real estate photo, Scandinavian farmhouse style, realistic proportions, clean and calm, no people, no text, no labels, no logos, no brand names, plain unbranded packets and tins with no prints, high detail. Palette: white oak, cream, sage green, terracotta accents, natural daylight. A white oak kitchen worktop covered with the contents of an emptied kitchen cupboard sorted into four neat groups: a group of plain tins, a group of plain dry goods packets and jars, a group of baking trays and chopping boards, and a small group of things to give away in a cardboard box. In the background a sage green base cupboard stands open and completely empty, its shelf wiped clean. Eye-level view.

items.name: 03-pans
items.prompt: Photorealistic interior photography, Scandinavian farmhouse style, realistic proportions, clean and calm, no people, no text, no labels, no logos, no brand names, high detail. Palette: white oak, cream, sage green, natural daylight. Looking down into a wide deep pan drawer pulled out from a sage green kitchen base unit under a white oak worktop. Inside the drawer: three plain stainless steel saucepans nested by size, a frying pan standing upright, and pan lids standing on edge in a simple metal lid rack along one side of the drawer. Everything fits inside the drawer walls, organised and easy to see.

items.name: 04-corner
items.prompt: Photorealistic interior photography, Scandinavian farmhouse style, realistic proportions, clean and calm, no people, no text, no labels, no logos, no brand names, plain unbranded bottles and jars with no prints, high detail. Palette: white oak, cream, sage green, natural daylight. Inside a white kitchen base cupboard with its door out of frame, seen from the front: a round white turntable lazy Susan sits on the cupboard shelf holding plain glass bottles of oil and vinegar and plain jars of sauces, and next to it on the same shelf a small two-tier white wire shelf riser holds plain tins. Clean white interior, items fully inside the cupboard and resting on the shelf.

items.name: 05-door
items.prompt: Photorealistic interior photography, Scandinavian farmhouse style, realistic proportions, clean and calm, no people, no text, no labels, no logos, no brand names, plain unbranded items with no prints, high detail. Palette: white oak, cream, sage green, natural daylight. A sage green kitchen cupboard door standing open, showing the inside of the door: a slim white metal rack screwed to the inside of the door holding plain foil and baking paper rolls, and two small hooks holding a tea towel and a set of measuring spoons. The rack is shallow and sits between the shelves without touching them. Inside the cupboard behind, neat shelves with plain jars.

items.name: 06-before
items.prompt: Edit this photo: keep exactly the same kitchen, same camera angle, same green base units, same oak worktop, same open wall cupboards and the same light. Make the cupboard shelves messy and overcrowded: mismatched plates and bowls stacked unevenly, packets and boxes of food crammed in at odd angles, mugs jumbled, a couple of plastic containers and lids balanced on top, everything disorganised. No people, no text, no logos, no readable packaging.

items.name: 07-pin
items.prompt: Photorealistic interior photography, real estate photo, Scandinavian farmhouse style, realistic proportions, clean and calm, no people, no text, no labels, no logos, no brand names, plain unbranded jars with no prints, high detail. Palette: white oak, cream, sage green, terracotta accents. A cosy British kitchen in warm evening light from under-cabinet lights, no candles. A sage green wall cupboard with its doors removed shows neatly organised shelves: matching plain clear jars of pasta and rice, stacked white plates and a row of mugs. Below it a white oak worktop with a terracotta jug of wooden spoons and a small plant. The top third of the image is calm plain wall and ceiling with nothing on it. One clear focal point.
